article.title: From capitalist crisis to crisis of whiteness: Rubio, Western decline, and the defense of white supremacy
article.author: Ajamu Baraka
article.content: Marco Rubio's appeals to Western civilization, Christian heritage, and the defense of Western dominance are fundamental to the consolidating global fascist project, functioning to transform a crisis of political economy into a crisis of what he and others refer to as civilization. The post From capitalist crisis to crisis of whiteness: Rubio, Western decline, and the defense of white supremacy appeared first on MR Online .
